scopes.why: Identify the Google account. No mailbox content.
Enforce exactly yoni122222@gmail.com. Wrong account is rejected and token revoked.
List and read messages plus attachments for claim import. Does not delete, move, or mark read.
Create drafts only. Google compose also permits send; app hard-blocks messages.send and drafts.send until a later owner PASS.

tokenStorage: public.claims_gmail_connection.refresh_token on Staging. RLS on. REVOKE ALL from anon/authenticated. Edge service_role only. Never returned to frontend. No Gmail password stored.
revoke: Claims Gmail view → בטל חיבור Gmail (super_admin), and Google Account → Third-party access.
workerIsolation: Workers never receive the Google token and do not open Gmail.com. list_messages, import_message, and create_draft require claims_can_work_claim.
